title: Albumblätter - No. 2
notable_excerpt: Key: A minor. Chord journey: V7 - iii - i - i64 loop, iv - bVII - III (Picardy-like major) - bVI - iii, returns to i and closes on v. Texture: eighth-note melody over a warm chordal accompaniment.
video_use_ideas: Sketch material for a film-score cue: take the opening bars and re-orchestrate.
legal_notes: Composer died 1856 (PD). Bar count matches the scan, 0 wrong-length bars, model self-estimate rhythm ~99%, pitch ~98% (an independent spot check of a GPT-6.1 Sol piece found pitch ~85% against a claimed 98%, so treat pitch claims as optimistic). MAY CONTAIN WRONG NOTES. Slurs, pedal and most ornaments not encoded. Transcription released CC0. MusicXML: files/scores/schumann_op124_albumblaetter_2.musicxml. Fills complete-set gap: Schumann Albumblätter Op. 124. No pre-rendered preview: the site plays the score MIDI with an in-browser General MIDI synth; no third-party recording.
